title: Change the program
starter:
%x = param [] slot=0 dtype=i32 addrspace=ALU
%a   = add %x 3
%out = mul %a 2
hints: Only the last line needs to change.
`mul` takes two values. Right now the second one is the number 2.
A name can be used twice on one line: `mul %a %a` multiplies `%a` by itself.
explain: `%a` already holds x + 3, so `%out = mul %a %a` multiplies that value by itself. A name stands for a value you already made, and you can use it as many times as you like.
